main_text.p: μετ᾽ αὐτὸν Ἰωάνης ὁ ταῦτα γεάψας. εἶπεν ὅτι καθὼς, ἡ πᾶσα ἡ τῶν Ῥωμαίων Ἐκκλησία μέχρι [?] λύεω ἐκφάπος, συμπεριλαβεῖ πάντας καὶ σὺν αὐτῇ, καὶ σὺν μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ Παξιαρχας, ὧν ἐς διαπάξεις ἄπαν κεφατῶν καὶ αὐτόν. ὡς ἀδυνατὸν [?] ἔν τὰ Ἀλο ἡμέρας, καὶ τὰς διαταξεῖς ἐκείνων κεφατῶν, καὶ σὺν ἀποβλεπτις [?] τὴν διάταξιν ἐκείνων διηβλωσ εἰς ἱερασιαύλου τὸ σύνολον, ἀλλὰ μόνον ἀφλύρις αὐτὸν, καὶ καινωνίας διδορίαν ἀπο-λαβὼν οἷα λαϊκοὺς, ὡς ἁπλῶς διδάλωκεν.

Neque ignorandum, Mapam illum Neocæsa-riensem Metropolitam Stylianum septennio post quam Epistolam a Formoso, de qua supra scrip-ptum est, acceperat, stolida per amicos, & cog-natos superbia elatum, relicto veritatis tramite in contraria versum dogmata, scripsisse Romam, petiuisseque ordinationem ipsius, & facultatem communicandi cum Photianis. Papa vero Ioannes cum huiusce modi Mapæ petitio-nem accepisset, perpendisset atque, veritus, ne forte per irrisionem, & contemptum haec scripta essent, neue Græci luderent Romanos, si illorum petitioni satisfeciisset, neque concessit, quod petiuit, neque sua manu rescripsit: sed ad illius literas in hunc modum respondit. Gratias, quas par est, honoratissime frater, tua charitati habemus, quod nunquam a matre tua, Sancta inquam, & Catholica, Apostolicaque Romana Ecclesia deficere volueris: nulla quippe tormen-

page.notes: Greek lines are only partly legible at this scan resolution; doubtful words are marked [?] and the line-end forms should be checked against a higher-resolution image. "ne-" at the end of a Latin line is read as the start of "ne forte" with a line-end dash; it may be a printing dash rather than a hyphen. Printed irregularities such as "γεάψας", "Mapam", and "volueris" are left as printed or read as printed. Scan of the last line is faint.
